parsed_entries.requirement: The Board may close proceedings or proceed under section 33 after giving the person concerned an opportunity of being heard.
parsed_entries.checkable_test: Check if the Board provides an opportunity for the person concerned to be heard before closing proceedings or proceeding under section 33.
parsed_entries.applicability: Applicable to complaints under the DPDP Act 2023.
parsed_entries.notes: This clause outlines the procedural requirement for the Board to provide an opportunity for the person concerned to be heard before taking action.

parsed_entries.requirement: The Board may issue a warning or impose costs on a complainant if it deems the complaint false or frivolous.
parsed_entries.checkable_test: Verify if the Board has the authority to issue a warning or impose costs on a complainant for a false or frivolous complaint.
parsed_entries.applicability: Applicable to complaints under the DPDP Act 2023.
parsed_entries.notes: This clause establishes the Board's authority to take action against false or frivolous complaints.

parsed_entries.requirement: The Appellate Tribunal may entertain an appeal after the expiry of the period specified in sub-section (2) if there was sufficient cause for not preferring the appeal within that period.
parsed_entries.checkable_test: Check if the Appellate Tribunal allows appeals after the expiry of the specified period if there was sufficient cause for delay.
parsed_entries.applicability: Applicable to appeals under the DPDP Act 2023.
parsed_entries.notes: This clause outlines the conditions under which the Appellate Tribunal may entertain an appeal after the expiry of the specified period.

parsed_entries.requirement: The Appellate Tribunal shall record its reasons in writing for not disposing of an appeal within six months.
parsed_entries.checkable_test: Verify if the Appellate Tribunal records its reasons in writing for not disposing of an appeal within six months.
parsed_entries.applicability: Applicable to appeals under the DPDP Act 2023.
parsed_entries.notes: This clause mandates the Appellate Tribunal to record reasons for delays in disposing of appeals.

parsed_entries.requirement: The Appellate Tribunal shall deal with an appeal under this section in accordance with such procedure as may be prescribed.
parsed_entries.checkable_test: Check if the Appellate Tribunal follows prescribed procedures for handling appeals under this section.
parsed_entries.applicability: Applicable to appeals under the DPDP Act 2023.
parsed_entries.notes: This clause requires the Appellate Tribunal to follow prescribed procedures for handling appeals.

parsed_entries.requirement: The provisions of section 18 of the Telecom Regulatory Authority of India Act, 1997 shall apply.
parsed_entries.checkable_test: Verify if the provisions of section 18 of the Telecom Regulatory Authority of India Act, 1997 apply to appeals under this section.
parsed_entries.applicability: Applicable to appeals under the DPDP Act 2023.
parsed_entries.notes: This clause mandates the application of section 18 of the Telecom Regulatory Authority of India Act, 1997 to appeals under the DPDP Act 2023.

parsed_entries.requirement: An order passed by the Appellate Tribunal under this Act shall be executable by it as a decree of civil court.
parsed_entries.checkable_test: Check if the Appellate Tribunal's order is executable as a decree of civil court.
parsed_entries.applicability: Applicable to orders passed by the Appellate Tribunal under the DPDP Act 2023.
parsed_entries.notes: This clause establishes the executability of the Appellate Tribunal's orders as decrees of civil court.

parsed_entries.requirement: The Board may direct the parties concerned to attempt resolution of the dispute through mediation if it deems the complaint may be resolved by mediation.
parsed_entries.checkable_test: Verify if the Board has the authority to direct parties to resolve disputes through mediation if it deems the complaint may be resolved by mediation.
parsed_entries.applicability: Applicable to complaints under the DPDP Act 2023.
parsed_entries.notes: This clause outlines the Board's authority to direct mediation for resolving disputes.
